questions.questionText: Label the water cycle diagram. Drag the correct labels to each part:
questions.explanation: Great job! The water cycle has four main parts: evaporation (water turning to vapor), condensation (vapor forming clouds), precipitation (water falling from clouds), and collection (water gathering in oceans and lakes).

questions.questionText: Put the water cycle steps in the correct order:
questions.explanation: Perfect! You understand the water cycle sequence. Water moves in a continuous cycle from Earth to the atmosphere and back again.

questions.questionText: Match each vocabulary word to its definition:

correctAnswer.Evaporation: Water turning from liquid to gas
correctAnswer.Collection: Water gathering in lakes and oceans

questions.explanation: Excellent vocabulary knowledge! These are the key terms of the water cycle.

questions.questionText: Which of these are types of precipitation? Check all that apply:
questions.explanation: Correct! Precipitation is water that falls from clouds. Rain, snow, hail, and sleet are all types of precipitation.

questions.questionText: True or False: Clouds are made of cotton balls.
questions.explanation: False! Clouds are made of millions of tiny water droplets, not cotton balls.

questions.questionText: True or False: The sun's heat causes water to evaporate.
questions.explanation: True! The sun provides the heat energy that causes water to evaporate.

questions.questionText: What happens to water vapor when it rises high in the sky and gets cold?
questions.correctAnswer: It condenses into tiny water droplets
questions.explanation: Correct! When water vapor rises and cools, it condenses into tiny water droplets that form clouds.

questions.questionText: Why do puddles disappear on sunny days?
questions.correctAnswer: The sun heats the water and it evaporates
distractors: The water soaks into the ground completely
questions.explanation: Great thinking! Puddles disappear because the sun's heat causes the water to evaporate into water vapor.

questions.questionText: What is the correct definition of precipitation?
questions.correctAnswer: Water that falls from clouds to the ground
questions.explanation: Perfect! Precipitation is any form of water that falls from clouds, including rain, snow, sleet, and hail.

questions.questionText: Draw and label a complete water cycle showing evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection:
questions.correctAnswer: Drawing with all 4 stages labeled correctly
questions.explanation: Excellent work! You can now draw and explain the complete water cycle!
